incidents.name: Incident on 2010-10-28 05:39:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-10-28 05:39:00 - One of the file servers is acting up. Looking into it.
  • 2010-10-28 05:40:00 - Failed over to slave. All systems go. Investigating root cause.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-10-26 12:30:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-10-26 12:30:00 - fs7 fail over. Some git repositories were unavailable for 30 minutes.
  • 2010-10-26 13:00:00 - Everything operating normally

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-10-21 07:04:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-10-21 07:04:00 - Site is offline. We're researching the issue.
  • 2010-10-21 07:18:00 - Lost a switch, which cascaded into fileserver failures. New switch is almost ready and we're bringing file servers back up.\r\n\r\nUPDATE: This was largely inaccurate. Apologies. -Ryan
  • 2010-10-21 07:50:00 - And we're back.\r\n\r\nThe root cause was a long-running database query blocking all other connections, which cascaded into issues across a large number of other servers. Blog post with more detail forthcoming.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-10-19 15:51:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-10-19 15:51:00 - The GitHub Pages server is down hard. We're researching the issue now.
  • 2010-10-19 15:53:00 - Pages server is back for the time being. We want to run some checks before we go green.
  • 2010-10-19 16:10:00 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-10-12 23:22:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-10-12 23:22:00 - fs5 is having problems. git and site access for users on that fileserver may be disrupted. We're researching the issue now.
  • 2010-10-12 23:41:00 - fs5 is back after coming under high load and failing over. We're researching the cause.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-10-12 20:37:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-10-12 20:37:00 - A fileserver went offline. We're researching the issue.
  • 2010-10-12 20:50:00 - The fileserver is back online and serving requests. The issue was tracked down to a haproxy misconfiguration. We're rolling out a fix now to prevent the problem in the future.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-09-28 14:51:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-09-28 14:51:00 - We're having issues with all git:// for all repos. You can still use the SSH and HTTP URLs to get your Git repo data while we fix this.
  • 2010-09-28 16:29:00 - Git:// access has been restored to all repos. Sorry for the hassles! We'll have a blog post about it later today.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-09-27 03:35:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-09-27 03:35:00 - One of the file servers is acting up. Researching now.
  • 2010-09-27 03:35:00 - Everything operating normally

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-09-24 16:01:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-09-24 16:01:00 - Network issues are still causing some intermittent connection problems. We are looking into it.
  • 2010-09-24 18:55:00 - Low memory on the load balancers was causing ldirectord to go into swap, which caused git, SSH, and HTTP connection errors. We've increased the memory allocation on those machines and are taking measures to make sure it doesn't happen again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-09-23 20:03:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-09-23 20:03:00 - Site is unreachable due to some kind of network issue. We're investigating...
  • 2010-09-23 20:04:00 - Site's back, and we're looking into what caused the problems.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-09-21 11:06:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-09-21 11:06:00 - Site unreachable due to a network error of some kind.
  • 2010-09-21 11:29:00 - Site's back. We're researching the cause of the issue.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-08-30 17:47:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-08-30 17:47:00 - There is a problem with one of the file servers. Looking into it.
  • 2010-08-30 18:01:00 - Double failover of FS6 pair means a few more minutes to sync up the DRBD volumes, then we can get it back online.
  • 2010-08-30 18:26:00 - FS6 is back online and serving requests.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-08-27 17:52:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-08-27 17:52:00 - Another file server is acting up. We're looking into it.
  • 2010-08-27 18:22:00 - The file server was brought back online.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-08-27 16:01:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-08-27 16:01:00 - One of the file servers is acting up. Looking into it.
  • 2010-08-27 16:21:00 - File server has been calmed and is back to work.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-08-12 00:00:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-08-12 00:00:00 - The connection between one of our application servers and one of the database servers seems to be down. We're investigating.
  • 2010-08-12 00:24:00 - All better. Looking into the root cause.
